segments.name: Lithium-ion Energy Storage Solutions
segments.description: Designs, develops, manufactures and sells lithium-ion energy storage solutions for material handling, airport ground support equipment and other industrial and commercial applications.
segments.evidence: We design, develop, manufacture, and sell a portfolio of advanced lithium-ion energy storage solutions for electrification of a range of industrial and commercial sectors which include material handling and airport ground support equipment ("GSE").

revenueModel.text: Customers purchase energy storage systems and battery management solutions as alternatives to traditional lead acid and propane-based solutions for their equipment fleets.
revenueModel.evidence: We believe our mobile energy storage solutions provide our customers with a reliable, high performing, cost effective, and more environmentally friendly alternative as compared to traditional lead acid and propane-based solutions.
